jobs.title: Intermediate Architectural Project Manager
jobs.description:
Intermediate or Senior Architectural Project Manager – Public Projects

Architecture, & Design Firm

Salary: $80,000–$115000 + bonus, benefits

Remote - Anywhere in Canada

The Company

A well-established and highly regarded Architecture, Design & Planning firm is seeking an Intermediate or Senior Architectural Project Manager
to join its growing team. The firm has a strong and varied project portfolio spanning public, institutional, and private-sector developments.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced architectural professional looking to take on greater project responsibility within a collaborative and progressive practice.

THE ROLE

As an Intermediate or Senior Architectural Project Manager
, you will play an integral role in the delivery of projects from design development through construction documentation and construction administration. Working alongside senior architects and project leaders, you will coordinate project teams, consultants, clients, and external stakeholders to ensure projects remain on track.

You will contribute to project planning, documentation, quality control, scheduling, and budget management while maintaining strong communication throughout the project lifecycle. You will also liaise with municipal authorities and assist with resolving technical and project-related issues as they arise. This role can be worked fully remotely.

What's Required

8–15 years of relevant architectural experience, with a minimum of 3 to 4 years working in a Project Management role/capacity within Architecture on larger architecture projects
Experience delivering projects from design through construction
Exposure to larger public-sector or institutional projects strongly preferred - whether within the public sector/client side or in a consulting firm
Eligibility to obtain the required Security Clearance
Minimum 5 years of experience working with Canadian building codes and municipal bylaws
Strong understanding of building technology, including wood-frame, steel, and concrete construction
Experience working with project financials, budgets, schedules and resource allocation on projects
PMP designation an asset, or other professional registration
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
Excellent organizational and time-management abilities
Demonstrated ability to coordinate project teams and manage schedules, budgets/resource allocation, and project deliverables
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality

What You Get In Return

Join an award-winning firm with an impressive portfolio of projects
Collaborative, supportive, and forward-thinking workplace
Competitive salary, bonus, benefits, and additional perks
Opportunities for professional development and career progression
Remote work model, with some occasional travel across Canada required
Stable position with a well-established and respected firm
Opportunity to take on increasing project responsibility and grow within the organization

What To Do Now

If you are an experienced architectural professional looking for an opportunity to advance your Project Management career, we'd like to hear from you. Please click Apply
and submit your resume, or contact Laura at
lshalev@talentsphere.ca
for more information.

We appreciate all applications; however, only candidates whose qualifications align with the requirements of the position will be contacted.

Intermediate Architectural Project Manager, Architectural Project Manager, Architectural Project Lead, Vancouver, Remote, Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Saskatchewan, Toronto, Ontario, Ottaw

Who We Are:

TrustedTech is a leading Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) specializing in Microsoft Cloud services, Microsoft perpetual licensing, and Microsoft Support Services for medium and enterprise-sized businesses. Our robust team of in-house, U.S-based Microsoft architects and engineers are certified in all 6/6 Microsoft Solutions Partner Designations in the Microsoft Cloud Partner Program.

Prioritizing a people-centric mission, TrustedTech has transformed the Microsoft software licensing experience, giving IT professionals complete confidence in the success of their Microsoft investment.

Overview:

The Project Manager
for Professional Services will be responsible for full ownership of Professional Services projects, from intake through execution and closure, ensuring delivery on time, within scope, and within budget. This role works closely with Delivery Managers, Cloud Delivery Architects, Account Managers, and clients to provide white-glove service and maintain TrustedTech's standards for quality and execution.

Responsibilities:

Project Lifecycle Management

Own and manage Professional Services projects from intake through closure, ensuring scope, timeline, and budget adherence.
Translate the signed statement of work into a detailed project plan, defining phases, milestones, and resource needs.
Lead project kickoff sessions, aligning internal teams and clients on goals, roles, and success criteria.
Conduct post-project evaluations to capture lessons learned and close out projects cleanly.

Stakeholder Engagement & Alignment

Serve as the primary point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
Coordinate cross-functional resources, including architects, vendors, and partners.
Lead internal and client meetings, ensuring accountability and follow-through.
Facilitate alignment on priorities and decisions, resolving conflicts between stakeholders as they arise.

Project Delivery & Performance Oversight

Monitor risks, dependencies, and progress, proactively escalating issues to leadership as needed.
Oversee day-to-day project execution, ensuring deliverables meet quality standards and client expectations.
Track project performance against scope, budget, and timeline, adjusting plans as needed to stay on course.
Identify and resolve delivery bottlenecks, escalating unresolved issues to leadership.

Documentation & Reporting

Maintain accurate project documentation, including project plans, schedules, risk/issue logs, and change records.
Deliver weekly project status reports to clients and internal stakeholders, highlighting progress, risks, and upcoming milestones.
Track and document scope changes, ensuring change orders are properly reviewed and recorded.
Maintain a centralized repository of project artifacts for audit and reference purposes.

Process & SOP Development

Support continuous improvement of PMO templates, standards, and processes.
Identify recurring inefficiencies in project delivery and recommend process improvements.
Contribute to the development of playbooks and best practices for common engagement types.
Ensure project execution aligns with established PMO governance and quality standards.

Schedule & Timeline Management

Develop and maintain detailed project schedules and communication strategies aligned with project objectives, ensuring on-time delivery across the project lifecycle.
Identify schedule risks early and build contingency plans to protect key milestones.
Adjust project timelines as scope or resource changes occur, communicating impacts to stakeholders.
Coordinate with internal teams to align resource availability with project schedules.

Required Skills & Qualifications (must-haves):

Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
7+ years of project management experience.
Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment.
Understanding of Waterfall, Agile, or hybrid project methodologies.
Strong communication skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Proficient in managing multiple projects simultaneously while delivering high-quality, white-glove service.
Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Knowledge of relevant software, such as Microsoft Office 365, Salesforce, and PSA/project management tools.
Adapts well to fast-paced, dynamic environments with shifting priorities.
Ability to meet deadlines and work under pressure independently, as well as in a team setting.
Must demonstrate an advanced level of computer skills, including Microsoft Word and Excel.

Preferred Skills & Qualifications (nice-to-haves):

Previous experience as a technical project manager within the Microsoft cloud solutions realm.

Job Requisition ID #

26WD99757

Position Overview

As a Senior Program Manager in Go-to-Market Transformation and Programs at Autodesk, you will lead small-to-medium GTM programs end-to-end, or significant workstreams within larger transformation and growth programs.

You will translate program objectives into integrated plans, operating rhythms, and clear execution paths that help teams deliver measurable business outcomes. You will partner with cross-functional stakeholders and senior leaders to clarify scope, manage dependencies, surface tradeoffs, and facilitate timely decisions. You will bring structure to ambiguous work, maintain momentum across teams, and ensure risks, decisions, and next steps are visible and actionable.You bring strong program management discipline, sound judgment, and collaborative influence to your work. You are comfortable operating with limited direction on how to execute, while aligning plans and recommendations to GTM priorities and stakeholder objectives.

This position is hybrid/remote and reports to the Senior Manager of GTM PMO.

Responsibilities

Lead small-to-medium GTM transformation and growth programs, or defined workstreams within larger programs, from planning through execution, launch readiness, and stabilization
Develop and own integrated program plans with clear milestones, deliverables, dependencies, owners, and measurable outcomes aligned to GTM priorities
Design and manage program governance, operating cadence, and stakeholder forums that create visibility, accountability, and forward momentum within the program scope
Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Enablement, Operations, Product, Technology, and Data stakeholders to align plans, manage dependencies, and resolve blockers within scope
Facilitate cross-functional alignment by understanding stakeholder goals, constraints, and incentives, and by connecting the right people to move work forward
Frame decisions clearly with options, tradeoffs, implications, and recommended next steps to enable timely decisions at the appropriate level
Identify and diagnose risks, dependencies, scope tradeoffs, and root causes; propose practical mitigation options and escalate thoughtfully when needed
Create clear, executive-ready program updates, dashboards, and summaries that communicate progress, risks, outcomes, and decisions needed
Design change, enablement, readiness, and adoption plans within programs by identifying impacted audiences, sequencing dependencies, and partnering with enablement and change team
Ensure launch-to-run readiness by defining ownership, support needs, hypercare plans, and post-launch stabilization activities
Apply PMO standards, tools, templates, and best practices consistently while contributing feedback and improvements based on program learnings
Lead workstreams or small teams through ambiguity, model strong program behaviors, and provide peer guidance, feedback, and coaching when appropriate

Minimum Qualifications

5+ years of relevant experience, including 2+ years managing cross-functional programs, workstreams, or GTM initiatives with measurable business outcomes
Experience designing and executing integrated program plans, managing dependencies, and driving delivery across multiple stakeholders or functions
Strong ability to navigate ambiguity, organize complex work, manage scope tradeoffs, and convert objectives into clear plans and next steps
Demonstrated ability to partner with Sales, Customer Success, Enablement, Operations, Product, Technology, or related GTM teams to align program objectives and execution plans
Experience facilitating decisions, documenting options and tradeoffs, and preparing clear materials for senior stakeholders
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize inputs from multiple viewpoints into clear recommendations and program narratives
Experience using PMO tools, program trackers, dashboards, and shared documentation to maintain a trusted source of truth
Working knowledge of GTM data, systems, and reporting concepts, with the ability to use data to support program decisions and status reporting
PMP, Change Management, Agile, or related certifications preferred; practical application of program management methods is valued over strict methodology adherence
Willingness to travel up to 25% as needed

Recommend improvements to project management processes, tools, and workflows.
Promote effective communication and collaboration between Sales, Operations, Engineering, and Installation teams.

Experience managing project budgets, schedules, resources, and deliverables.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Title:
Project Manager, Class Giving

Main Work Location:
Historic Main Campus

Schedule:
Hybrid (at least 2 days a week on-site)

Budgeted Salary Range:
The targeted pay range for this position is $93,000 to $96,000 per annum.

To Apply:
Please submit a cover letter and résumé along with your online application.

About Class Giving

Reunion giving is a cherished tradition at Stanford University. Class Giving fosters the tradition of class connection and philanthropy through robust reunion campaigns, ranging from the 5th to the 70th reunions. Our frontline fundraising team works with undergraduate alumni to honor their time at Stanford and strengthen their lasting connection to the university through philanthropy. Working in concert with volunteers, donors and campus partners and leaders, OOD staff members strive to accelerate purposeful impact in the world. Stanford is committed to a donor-centric approach to development, and every member of the Office of Development plays a role in providing the university’s donors with the service and attention that ensures an exceptionally positive and fulfilling philanthropic experience.

Position Summary

The Class Giving team is seeking a Project Manager (PM) to partner with our front-line fundraisers (Class Giving Officers) throughout the reunion campaign cycle. Covering annual, leadership, and major giving, the PM will be involved with prospect discovery, qualification, volunteer management, and stewardship.

This role supports high volume, high touch activities and deliverables to determine and execute on program needs. The Project Manager is a key partner to both fundraisers and volunteers, providing insightful guidance to meet goals, develop, and lead automated processes using tools like Airtable, ThruText, Marketo, and others.

This role works directly with undergraduate alumni, donors, volunteers, and staff to build and maintain relationships across the university community.

What We're Looking For

Strong data acumen and communication skills
Creative, outside-the-box thinking
A team player who looks out for colleagues and the program as a whole
Customer service orientation — comfortable managing relationships with university partners, donors, and volunteers
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
A positive, can-do attitude with the flexibility to adapt as priorities shift
A growth mindset and willingness to learn new processes and systems
Familiarity with fundraising databases and tools (e.g. Airtable, Marketo, ThruText, AI) and prior experience in nonprofit or higher education a plus.

Areas Of Responsibility

Leadership: collaborating strategically with Class Giving Officers to ascertain needs and goals across the 18+ month reunion campaign cycle.
Operations: coordinating priorities and workflows supporting reunion campaigns across multiple class-year cohorts.
Partnerships: surpassing expectations for donors and alumni, as well as, volunteers, and university partners.
Volunteer Support: in partnership with Class Giving Officers, providing ongoing support to volunteers once onboarded, ensuring they have the tools, information, and resources needed to carry out their roles effectively.
Process Management: designing, automating, and leading effective process strategies to meet Class Giving's operational demands.
Activity Management: operating and learning tracking models using dashboards and reports to manage volunteer and donor pipeline activities, gift tracking, and campaign progress across class years.

Responsibilities

Core Duties
:

Partner with gift officers, stewardship, marketing and event planning staff in the planning and implementation of donor cultivation and stewardship, alumni, and special recognition events.
Draft and help prepare materials, including proposals, detailed donor visit briefings for senior university leaders and faculty, background documents, gift acknowledgements and stewardship materials.
Track, analyze and report on fundraising progress against goals and objectives for specific programs, as assigned.
Provide recommendations to marketing and communications staff in the writing and production of fundraising materials, including specialized appeals and other development communications.
Provide development program reporting and analysis to support fundraising strategies.
Retrieve information about prospects and donors, manage data input, and generate complex reports using the university external relations database.
Troubleshoot gift and payment issues, ensuring accurate donor record keeping, and driving complex administrative issues to resolution.
Track budget(s) and conduct financial projections for department.
Train and supervise the duties of event students, workers, and volunteers.

Minimum Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree and two years of relevant experience or combination of education and relevant experience.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Advanced ability with Microsoft Office suite.
Proficiency with database systems, such as Microsoft Access.
Strong data analysis skills including experience gathering, organizing and analyzing data, and communicating/presenting results and recommendations in a succinct fashion to key stakeholders.
Ability to work efficiently, juggle tasks simultaneously, meet deadlines, and achieve goals.
Excellent interpersonal skills, and ability to interact with a wide range of people.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Vendor and Scaled Operations
jobs.description:
Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.

About The Service Operations Team

We're a tight-knit team of program management, process & automation, and workforce management professionals working together to deliver world-class service through operational excellence and strategic enablement. We collaborate closely with frontline Service, Business Apps, QA, Enablement, and Analytics teams to plan and deliver on complex initiatives that improve processes, tools, and how our service operates day-to-day. Our focus is on creating service experiences that are both efficient for our operations team while providing an excellent experience for our customers and pros.

About The Role

As a Senior Program Manager, Vendor & Scaled Operations within Thumbtack's Service Operations PMO, you will own our outsourced and scaled delivery model - the strategy, the governance, and the long-horizon programs that determine how a meaningful share of our service gets delivered. This is not a generalist PM role. It is purpose-built for someone who can hold a commercial relationship, an operational system, and an executive narrative at the same time.

You will own Thumbtack's vendor and BPO strategy for Service Operations end to end: how we decide what to outsource, how we hold partners accountable, how we govern performance, and how we scale or unwind capacity as the business changes. You'll own a portfolio of scaled operations and partner support programs spanning a year or more, with real interdependencies between them, and you'll make the prioritization and capacity calls across that portfolio rather than escalating them.

You'll also be the person leadership turns to for the make-versus-buy conversation. Expect to build the cost, quality, and risk case for how we scale, bring it to senior leaders and to vendor executives, and then be accountable for the model you recommended.

This is a high-leverage, high-ambiguity role. Much of the infrastructure you'll need does not fully exist yet, and building it durably - so it outlasts you - is a core part of the job.

What You’ll Do

Own Thumbtack's vendor and outsourcing strategy for Service Operations - sourcing decisions, make-versus-buy recommendations, capacity strategy across internal, vendor, and partner channels, and the case for expanding, consolidating, or exiting a partner. Own the commercial relationship alongside Legal, Finance, and Procurement (SOWs, rate structures, SLA credits and remedies, renewals) and know which levers to pull when performance slips.
Design and optimize the governance model for vendor performance: SLA and scorecard architecture, QBR structure, decision rights, escalation paths, and remediation playbooks. Build durable frameworks, not one-off trackers.
Own a portfolio of programs. Set the strategy, sequence the work, decide what does and doesn't get done, drive it to business-level outcomes, and establish the operating rhythms - cadences, decision logs, dependency tracking, escalation thresholds, change communication - that keep distributed, multi-party delivery predictable.
Build the measurement framework for the scaled delivery model: quality, SLA attainment, forecast accuracy, cost-to-serve, and the leading indicators that reveal a program is silently degrading before the lagging metrics do. Define what "good" looks like and close the loop so performance data actually changes behavior - on our side and the vendor's.
Align senior leaders and lead the change. Bring executives across Service Operations, IT, Legal, Finance, Product, and Workforce Management to a decision on sourcing priorities and tradeoffs, translating tangled multi-party problems into a clear recommendation - then drive adoption through teams and partners who don't report to you, including the unglamorous follow-through that determines whether change sticks.
Raise the bar on how this work gets done. Identify and build AI and automation that reduces coordination overhead and improves oversight at scale, and coach other program managers while institutionalizing what works into playbooks and standards, so every future partnership starts from a higher floor.

In order to be successful, you must bring

8+ years in program or project management, including 3+ years owning vendor, BPO, or outsourced delivery relationships at scale. Experience with multiple vendors, multiple sites, or a vendor transition is strongly preferred. Proficiency in program management tooling (e.g., Jira, Linear, Coda, Smartsheet) and fluency across Agile and Waterfall approaches. PMP, PgMP, or equivalent is nice-to-have.
Deep vendor ownership and sourcing judgment. You've personally owned an outsourcing relationship end to end - commercial terms, governance, performance management, escalation, and the hard conversations - not just coordinated with one someone else owned. You've also built and defended a make-versus-buy or vendor expansion case with cost, quality, and risk modeling, and taken it to senior leadership.
Portfolio-level ownership. You've run multiple concurrent scale programs with genuine tradeoffs between them, and owned the prioritization and capacity calls yourself. You've run programs where consistency of human execution at volume is the product - you know how to design for repeatability, and you spot degradation from leading indicators rather than after the fact.
A track record of building durable infrastructure. SLA and scorecard architecture, governance models, transition playbooks, reporting systems - things other teams adopted and still use. You build and maintain the models, dashboards, and SLA tracking yourself rather than waiting for someone else to instrument it.
Comfort where the playbook doesn't exist, and a habit of leaving people better than you found them. You've stepped into situations with no established approach and built one, with the judgment to know when structure helps and when it would slow things down - and you've mentored program managers or been the person other teams borrow practices from.

Expected salary ranges

For candidates living in Ontario and British Columbia, the expected total cash compensation (base salary + variable pay, if applicable) range for this role is currently $102,000 - $132,000

Actual offered salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as calibrated job level, qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, color, age, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, provincial, state, or local law. We also will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable law.

Thumbtack is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation for a medical condition or disability during any part of the application process, please contact: recruitingops@thumbtack.com.

jobs.title: Enterprise Asset Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD100705

Position Overview

The Enterprise Asset Program Manager is responsible for implementing, operationalizing, and owning Autodesk's enterprise hardware asset management capability across PCs, Macs, mobile phones, and other end-user hardware. This role serves as the accountable owner for establishing accurate, governed asset data as the trusted system of record across the full lifecycle, from catalog and standards definition through governance, financial strategy, and cross-departmental asset architecture.

This is a hands-on role. The person in this seat will personally build and operate these processes, carrying forward and executing on recommendations from a recent external assessment of Autodesk's fulfillment, distribution, and ITAD practices, not simply direct others toward them. The role is structured as an individual contributor today; prior experience leading people or cross-functional programs is valued for how someone approaches ownership and accountability, even without direct reports in this seat.

This role owns asset management for a global population of approximately 21,500 employees and contingent workers, covering an estimated 60,000+ devices across computers, mobile phones, and loaner and spare inventory. The role oversees a significant, multi-million dollar annual hardware program and is accountable for continuing this function's demonstrated track record of cost discipline and savings.

Responsibilities

Asset Program Architecture and Governance

Define the program's strategy, roadmap, and operating model, including cross-functional roles and governance cadences with Finance, Procurement, and Security, moving the program from initial implementation into stable, ongoing operations
Establish and enforce a hardware governance framework, including a governance board, ensuring standards stay current against the market and defined personas
Own and mature the customization and exception governance process for requests outside standard catalog offerings
Work across departments that use end-user hardware in an advisory and architectural capacity, including managing global VAR vendor relationships

Catalog and Standards

Define and implement persona-based hardware standards and device catalog tiers, informed by industry practice
Evaluate customization and upgrade requests on technical merit, distinguishing genuine need from preference
Build a compliance and security vetting process for new hardware models with the security team

Lifecycle Operations and Data Accuracy

Establish consistent controls across the full hardware lifecycle, from request and procurement through deployment, recovery, refresh, and secure disposal
Personally drive improvement of current asset database accuracy (approximately 60-70 percent today) and establish standards for data matching, reconciliation, and quality
Integrate asset management with discovery, endpoint management, identity, CMDB, procurement, and disposition systems, and align asset data with core ITSM processes
Drive automation of asset tracking and reconciliation workflows to reduce manual effort

Financial Strategy

Lead hardware asset financial planning, including budgeting, forecasting, and spend analysis, with CapEx versus OpEx fluency
Own financial reconciliation against purchasing, accounts payable, the fixed-asset register, and general ledger, resolving variances in cost, ownership, and capitalization
Develop and report on asset management KPIs and dashboards for senior leadership

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum 7 years of experience owning enterprise asset management programs end-to-end. Not just project managing them, but accountable for outcomes and deliverables over multiple years, and can speak to this experiences
Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience in a relevant field
Demonstrated experience operating at large enterprise scale (e.g., 50,000+ managed assets), including the systems, process rigor, and stakeholder complexity that scale requires
Hands-on experience with CMDB/ServiceNow data integration, including data hygiene, accuracy, and governance practices across device- and asset-level records
Demonstrated ability to manage the full asset lifecycle (procurement, provisioning, refresh, redeployment, disposition) across device types, including mobile devices
Experience setting up or operating within formal change management processes (e.g., ITIL change/release management)
An engineering mindset toward process and systems: comfortable applying structured, repeatable approaches to workflow design and systems integration
Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, and contract or vendor cost management
Ability to build and present materials for senior leadership, including governance documentation (RACI, SLAs, XLAs) and program status/metrics
Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with HR, Finance, Procurement, Security, and technical stakeholders
People leadership or management experience is a plus but not required for this role
Comfortable operating globally across time zones and driving change across regionally distributed teams
Experience with AI toolsets as its related to assets, systems, and asset data (CIs, etc.) a plus

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Benefits

From health and financial benefits to time away and everyday wellness, we give Autodeskers the best, so they can do their best work. Learn more about our benefits in the U.S. by visiting https://benefits.autodesk.com/

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For U.S.-based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $81,000 and $145,200. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. jobs.description:
About Us

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Program Manager for Viasat’s Government Services & Solutions business area, you will lead the execution of complex internal development programs that deliver secure, resilient, multi‑domain connectivity solutions supporting government and military missions worldwide. Your work will directly enable Viasat’s ability to connect users and platforms across air, land, and sea, ensuring reliable communications in highly contested and operationally demanding environments.

You will be responsible for driving projects that span software-defined networking, satellite communications (SATCOM), terminals, antennas, network infrastructure, and managed connectivity services, aligning technical execution with mission and customer requirements.

Success in this role requires the ability to influence diverse technical teams, align stakeholders around shared objectives, and maintain disciplined execution to meet cost, schedule, and technical requirements while managing risks.

The day-to-day

Be accountable for end‑to‑end program execution, managing cost, schedule, technical performance, and risk across multiple internal development efforts
Lead and coordinate cross‑functional teams including Engineering, Operations, Cyber & Information Security, and Finance
Influence teams and stakeholders who do not directly report to you, driving alignment and accountability in a matrixed environment
Plan, track, and report program performance using metrics, milestone tracking, and executive‑level status reporting
Manage program risks and opportunities, proactively identifying issues and driving resolution to meet program commitments
Ensure programs meet internal development objectives while supporting required certifications, security requirements, and compliance obligations
Adhere to Viasat’s development process (VGate)

What You'll Need

Bachelor’s degree in technical or business discipline, or equivalent relevant experience
10+ years of multifaceted Program or Project Management experience, including responsibility for cost, schedule, technical performance, and risk management
Strong experience leading large internal development programs, including software development, satellite networking, hub designs, satellite terminal and antennas, or systems‑of‑systems efforts
Proven ability to lead and collaborate within a highly matrixed organization
Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence, negotiate, and drive outcomes without direct authority
Ability to present technical and programmatic information at an abstracted level to senior leadership
Demonstrated hybrid Agile and predictive project execution methodologies and reporting
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills
U.S. Government position requiring U.S. Citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance

What Will Help You On The Job

Experience supporting satellite communications, networking, terminals, or complex integrated systems
Background working in government, defense, or other regulated environments
Experience supporting certifications, cybersecurity, and compliance requirements
Active DoD Clearance

Salary range

$147,500.00 - $233,000.00 / annually. For specific work locations within San Jose, the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, the base pay range for this role is $183,000.00- $275,000.00/ annually

jobs.title: Principal, Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Team

US Omni Tech at Walmart Global Tech, Bengaluru, is focused on improving Walmart customer experience across both physical & digital and make Walmart the most exciting place to shop. With 4000+ brick and mortar stores and thousands of other suppliers fulfilling Walmart's online/in-store orders for over 1 billion customers - the challenge and complexity is pronounced! We work within the world’s largest retailer yet maintain a start up feel working in small agile teams to revolutionize the fulfilment landscape. As a leader in the supply chain group, you are accountable and responsible for number of critical products/platforms that helps serve our customers in the most cost-effective manner in multiple geographies and businesses.

What You’ll Do

Your main responsibilities will revolve around managing large software development projects.

You will work closely with architects and engineering leaders to ensure the successful completion of these projects. To do this, you will need to have a deep understanding of software architecture and contribute to architectural decision-making processes.

You will also need to build strong relationships with stakeholders across Walmart, ensuring alignment on roles, responsibilities, and project cadences.

Your role will involve defining goals, stage gates, critical delivery paths, and key deliverables for large-scale programs that incorporate multiple programs with dependencies across multiple areas of work, timelines, and resource constraints.

Efficient engineering resource utilization and delivery will be a priority, and you will need to simplify and clarify priorities and create plans with appropriate milestones for advance planning and executive buy-in.

You will also establish a resource capacity allocation process and tool to transform the planning process.

Your problem-solving and decision-making skills will be crucial in navigating any setbacks or obstacles that may arise.

Overall, as a seasoned professional, your expertise and passion for driving technical projects to success will be invaluable in this role at Walmart Global Tech.

What You’ll Bring

A bachelor’s degree in computer science/engineering or equivalent.

Overall around 18+years of technical experience with 10+ years of leadership experience as a Technical Program Manager in software delivery within a related industry managing aggressive schedules and significant business impact.

Strong leadership skills, with the ability to effectively manage and motivate a team of technical program managers and engineers.

Experience supporting and executing a large software portfolio, collaborating with multiple business stakeholders.

Experienced in system/platform design concepts, architecture, technical design, services, APIs, and technologies.

Build positive relationships and collaborate with product managers to understand target personas and business process needs, which you will then translate into features and user stories that engineers will leverage to iterate products quickly.

Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a love for data and solving complex problems.

Expertise in change & risk management methodologies, project management tools, techniques, project tracking tools, dashboards, and reports

Strong communicator in both verbal and written forms and are equally adept in communicating upwards, outwards, and downward.

Deep understanding of JIRA, JIRA Align, Big Picture, Airtable etc.

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.

Flexible, hybrid work

Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Walmart, Inc., is an Equal Opportunities Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.

jobs.title: Sr. Lead Fraud Program Manager
jobs.description:
At Early Warning, we’ve powered and protected the U.S. financial system for over thirty years with cutting-edge solutions like Zelle®, Paze®, and so much more. As a trusted name in payments, we partner with thousands of institutions to increase access to financial services and protect transactions for hundreds of millions of consumers and small businesses.

Positions located in Scottsdale, San Francisco, Chicago, or New York follow a hybrid work model to allow for a more collaborative working environment.

Candidates responding to this posting must independently possess the eligibility to work in the United States, for any employer, at the date of hire. This position is ineligible for employment Visa sponsorship.

Overall Purpose

The Sr. Fraud Program Manager is responsible for leading and maturing key components of Paze’s Fraud Program to safeguard customers and protect the integrity of the platform.

This role operates at a strategic and executional level — owning large, complex, cross-functional fraud initiatives while influencing enterprise stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Operations.

The Sr. Lead partners closely with Fraud leadership to translate strategic objectives into scalable program structures, technical requirements, governance, and measurable outcomes. This position serves as the most senior individual contributor within the Fraud Risk Program function and may mentor other program managers.

Essential Functions

Lead the design, execution, and continuous improvement of major components of the Fraud Risk Program.
Translate fraud strategy into executable roadmaps, epics, features, and technical requirements.
Own delivery of large, complex, technology-intensive fraud initiatives spanning multiple interrelated workstreams.
Establish program governance frameworks, operating rhythms, KPIs, reporting mechanisms, and risk controls.
Proactively monitor fraud performance metrics relative to targets; identify emerging risks and drive mitigation strategies.
Lead program-level risk identification, issue resolution, and change control across cross-functional teams.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Security, Compliance, and Legal to align fraud risk capabilities with business strategy and roadmap priorities.
Drive vendor oversight for fraud-related third-party solutions, ensuring performance, compliance, and risk standards are met.
Develop and formalize fraud risk standards, policies, controls, and documentation aligned to regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
Influence decision-making at senior leadership levels through data-driven recommendations and executive-ready communication.
Mentor and provide guidance to other Fraud Risk Program Managers to elevate program delivery practices.
Support the company’s commitment to enterprise risk management and protection of systems and data integrity.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, Risk Management, or related field.
Typically, 12+ years of experience in banking, payments, fraud risk, or related risk management roles.
5+ years of experience leading large, complex, cross-functional fraud or payments programs.
Demonstrated experience delivering technology-intensive initiatives in partnership with engineering teams.
Advanced knowledge of fraud risk management tools, controls, governance models, and industry best practices.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
Proven ability to operate autonomously in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset.
PMP, Agile, Scrum, or equivalent program management certification (or equivalent experience).
Background and drug screen.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in digital banking, payments networks, or wallet ecosystems.
Deep familiarity with fraud analytics, decision engines, or risk platforms.
Experience scaling fraud programs in high-growth environments.
SAS, SQL, or comparable analytical coding experience.
Demonstrated experience mentoring or leading other program managers.

Physical Requirements

Working conditions consist of a normal office environment. Work is primarily sedentary and requires extensive use of a computer and involves sitting for periods of approximately four hours. Work may require occasional standing, walking, kneeling, and reaching. Must be able to lift 10 pounds occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently. Requires visual acuity and dexterity to view, prepare, and manipulate documents and office equipment including personal computers. Requires the ability to communicate with internal and/or external customers. Employee must be able to perform essential functions and physical requirements of position with or without reasonable accommodation.

Candidates responding to this posting must independently possess the eligibility to work in the United States at the date of hire.

The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow instructions and perform other related duties as assigned by their supervisor.

The Base Pay Scale For This Position In

Phoenix, AZ/ Chicago, IL / Washington, DC in USD per year is: $129,000 - $161,000.

New York, NY/ San Francisco, CA in USD per year is: $154,000 - $193,000.

Additionally, candidates are eligible for a discretionary incentive plan and benefits.This pay scale is subject to change and is not necessarily reflective of actual compensation that may be earned, nor a promise of any specific pay for any specific candidate, which is always dependent on legitimate factors considered at the time of job offer. Early Warning Services takes into consideration a variety of factors when determining a competitive salary offer, including, but not limited to, the job scope, market rates and geographic location of a position, candidate’s education, experience, training, and specialized skills or certification(s) in relation to the job requirements and compared with internal equity (peers). The business actively supports and reviews wage equity to ensure that pay decisions are not based on gender, race, national origin, or any other protected classes.

Some of the Ways We Prioritize Your Health and Happiness

Healthcare Coverage – Competitive medical (PPO/HDHP), dental, and vision plans as well as company contributions to your Health Savings Account (HSA) or pre-tax savings through flexible spending accounts (FSA) for commuting, health & dependent care expenses.
401(k) Retirement Plan – Featuring a 100% Company Safe Harbor Match on your first 6% deferral immediately upon eligibility.
Paid Time Off – Flexible Time Off for Exempt (salaried) employees, as well as generous PTO for Non-Exempt (hourly) employees, plus 11 paid company holidays and a paid volunteer day.
12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave
Maven Family Planning – provides support through your Parenting journey including egg freezing, fertility, adoption, surrogacy, pregnancy, postpartum, early pediatrics, and returning to work.

jobs.description:
About Marvell

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

Your Team, Your Impact

The IP program Manager will be part of Central Engineering’s program management team responsible for the IP development and delivery for Marvell’s products and custom silicon businesses, giving the opportunity to contribute to the successes of numerous Marvell programs.

What You Can Expect

The successful candidate will understand the SoC IP needs and develop plans to deliver and support the IP from conception through to program Mass Production Release (MPR). The successful candidate will have both depth and breadth in the related IP engineering that involve cross functional organizations, in the forms of analog, logic, design for test, layout, timing, validation, PnR, etc. Good understanding of technologies and IP development process and methodology are required. Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills are a must.

Overall responsibility for program management of IP development & delivery to Marvell product business units
Drive closure of IP specs & requirements
Demonstrated strong cross-functional leadership to chair weekly cross functional meetings assessing status, milestones, and completeness of plans with regular program updates to Marvell Executive stakeholders
Support Marvell’s Program Management Process
Matrixed leadership of engineering program managers distributed across the engineering organization
Execute lesson's learned, risk management, and enforce agreed to processes
Responsibility for the successful outcome of IP development & delivery

What We're Looking For

BS in Electrical Engineering and MSEE preferred
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related fields and 10-15 years of related professional experience, OR Master’s degree and/or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related fields with 5 -10 years of experience.
6+ years of experience as an Engineering Project Manager in the Semiconductor industry preferred
6+ years of experience as a mixed signal IP designer
Knowledge of SoC/IC design flow for advanced process technologies and process flows and methodologies in Silicon Development
Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills
Demonstrated ability to partner with technical managers to drive projects to completion
Demonstrated effective partnerships and relationships with key stakeholders
Excellent leadership skills
Must have a broad background in ASIC or other Microelectronics development

Expected Base Pay Range (USD)

Role Summary

Are you a highly experienced Technical Program Manager with a proven track record of successfully delivering high-quality software for evolving product platforms in complex, integrated software-hardware environments? We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented individual to take a leading role in managing the software delivery for new vehicle launches. As a critical member of our Software Technical Program Team, you will be instrumental in launching new vehicle variants and ensuring the seamless integration of new features, while upholding the highest standards of software quality.

Responsibilities

Define and drive comprehensive plans for software-impacting hardware changes and new software features, for both consumer and commercial vehicles
Influence company and program milestones to align with software schedules
Drive software-hardware integration efforts, acting as a principal liaison and problem-solver for the most challenging cross-domain dependencies
Cultivate strong working relationships across all levels of the organization and foster deep collaboration to ensure seamless software integration and the successful launch of new vehicle variants
Take ownership of prioritizing and driving the swift resolution of software issues that arise during development
Manage verification test plans tailored to the unique software and hardware configurations of new product variants
Deliver clear, concise, and insightful updates on the progress of software delivery to the program team, executive leadership, and key stakeholders
Proactively identify and strategically mitigate systemic risks to software delivery timelines or quality, implementing effective mitigation strategies and healthily escalating concerns as needed
Initiate, champion, and lead significant continuous process improvements within the software development lifecycle and program management frameworks
Mentor and provide technical guidance to other Technical Program Managers, fostering best practices and contributing to the growth and development of the program management function

Qualifications

BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field
6+ years of progressive Technical or Engineering Program Management experience, demonstrating a strong and successful track record in software delivery for complex, integrated software-hardware products at scale
Proven expertise in spearheading the strategic development and successful production launch of new products, particularly those with intricate interdependencies between software and electrical hardware systems
Exceptional communication, collaboration, and influencing skills, with a proven ability to effectively lead, align, and motivate diverse cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders in highly dynamic and ambiguous environments
Deep, practical mastery of both Agile and Waterfall development methodologies, with advanced proficiency in Jira and other program management tools to manage complex software delivery, and to define and implement best practices

Previous experience as a software or hardware product development engineer
Experience with over-the-air (OTA) software update strategies and deployment for connected devices or systems
Experience in the automotive industry

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. jobs.title: Project Manager — Customer & Technical Liaison
jobs.description:
Project Manager — Customer & Technical Liaison

Location: Hybrid, US Based
Employment Type: Full-time
Clearance: Active TS or Active TS/SCI with CT Polygraph
Travel: 60 -70%

About Terradepth

Terradepth is building the next generation of ocean technology by combining autonomous maritime hardware, software, data, and AI into an integrated Ocean Operating System. We work with government and commercial customers to solve complex problems in some of the world's most challenging environments.

The Role

We are looking for a Project Manager with 5–10 years of progressively responsible experience managing government programs and contracts. This person will manage multiple concurrent projects and serve as the connective tissue between our customers and internal Engineering, Product, Operations, Sales, and Finance teams.
The ideal candidate understands both the discipline required to execute federal contracts and the speed and flexibility required in a growing technology company. Experience with enterprise SaaS, maritime systems, defense technology, or complex hardware/software programs is highly desirable.
This is a hands-on role. You will be expected to own schedules, deliverables, customer communication, risks, budgets, and execution—not simply coordinate meetings.

Key Responsibilities

Manage multiple government and commercial projects from contract award through delivery, customer acceptance, invoicing support and closeout.
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, budgets, deliverables, and resource requirements.
Serve as the primary day-to-day program interface for assigned customers and build trusted relationships with technical, operational, contracting, and program stakeholders.
Actively develop and maintain customer relationships during project execution.
Translate contractual requirements into clear internal tasks, priorities, and deliverables.
Coordinate across Software Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Product, Operations, Sales, and Finance.
Track contractual deliverables including reporting requirements, invoicing milestones, project performance, risks, dependencies, issues, and corrective actions.
Maintain scope and change control by documenting customer requests, assessing their impact, and coordinating contract modifications when required.
Lead regular internal and customer project reviews.
Ensure contractual commitments and customer expectations are clearly understood and actively managed.
Support proposals, contract modifications, SOW development, and new business opportunities.
Identify project risks early and drive resolution rather than simply reporting problems.
Identify additional sales and technical opportunities within the project and relay to appropriate internal Terradepth personnel for further development.
Maintain appropriate program documentation and reporting for government customers.
Support customer demonstrations, testing, deployments, and operational activities as required.
Travel to customer and field sites as required.

What We're Looking For

5–10 years of progressive project/program management experience, preferably supporting federal government contracts.
At minimum, active TS or active TS/SCI with Polygraph required.
Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects or programs simultaneously.
Strong understanding of federal contracting, government customer expectations, and contract execution.
Experience managing technical programs involving software, hardware, data, or integrated systems.
Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS business models and software product delivery.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work effectively with engineers, executives, customers, and government stakeholders.
Highly organized, accountable, and comfortable operating with ambiguity.
Ability to identify what needs to happen next and drive the team toward completion without requiring constant direction.
Willingness to travel to customer sites and field operations as required.

Preferred Experience

Maritime, UUV/AUV, robotics, defense, ocean technology, or related industry experience.
Experience with DoD, IC, or other federal customers.
Experience managing programs involving both physical hardware and SaaS/software platforms.
Experience working with subcontractors, technology partners, and geographically distributed teams.
Experience with JIRA, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or comparable planning and execution tools.
Experience in a startup or high-growth technology company.
PMP or similar project/program management certification.

What Success Looks Like

Projects are delivered on time, on budget, and to customer expectations.
Internal teams have clear priorities, owners, and deadlines.
Customer commitments and contractual requirements are translated into executable internal plans, and program forecasts remain current.
Customers have confidence that Terradepth understands and will deliver against its commitments.
Risks and issues are surfaced early and actively resolved.
Multiple complex programs can move forward simultaneously without losing accountability or execution discipline.

This is a role for a project manager who wants to own outcomes, not just manage schedules. You should be comfortable operating between government customers, technical teams, and company leadership and bringing structure, urgency, and accountability to complex programs.

Facilitate governance bodies
Ensure compliance with decision making, financial monitoring and reporting policies
Ensure consistency of the project portfolio with the Group's strategic objectives and regulatory or internal compliance requirements
Translate HR needs into functional requirements and priorities
Identify, analyze and anticipate risks related to budget, planning, skills and dependencies between projects

Coordinate change management activities to ensure overall consistency of the change management plan

Work closely with IT, Finance, RISK, Compliance and HR departments
Facilitate sharing of best practices and lessons learned

Profile and Skills To Success

Master’s degree in Economics, Management, Engineering or related areas
Between 5 and 7 years of relevant experience in Project Management and Consulting preferably in Finance Sector
Experience in defining new operating models
Fluency in English, both oral and written
Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel and PowerPoint
Ability to manage a project’s full life-cycle: assessing, design and implementation
Excellent communication skills, along with the ability to manage or facilitate workshops, meetings and trainings
Ability to understand, explain and support change
Strong time management and organizational skills and critical thinking ability

Why joining BNP Paribas?

BNP Paribas, The European Leader In Banking And Financial Services In Europe, Operates In 64 Countries And Has Nearly 180,000 Employees. The Group Is Structured Around Three Operating Divisions. Its Business Lines Cooperate Closely, As Part Of Our Integrated Model, To Meet The Needs Of All Our Clients In a Coordinated Manner

Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB), connects corporate clients needing financing and institutional clients looking for investment opportunities;
Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS), brings together all the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses;

We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space.

Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart.

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality.

If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager
.

The Material Program Manager (level 5
) is responsible and accountable for the execution of material schedule and budget for Voyager Technologies, including program execution with key propulsion subcontractors. The MPM leads all phases of subcontract program execution. This includes developing supplier program management documentation such as monthly status reports, SRR/PDR/CDR materials, program planning documentation, and program management related CDRLs, and presenting subcontract program materials to technical teams, leadership, and customers. The Material Program Manager (MPM) is a unique position that requires strategic thinking as well as tactical execution allowing an individual to make immediate tangible impacts. A successful MPM can work with minimal supervision to solve complex problems to ensure both short term and long term success of their respective program. An MPM would need to possess strong hard skills to execute plans to completion, as well as soft skills to appropriately work with multiple disciplines, and communicate challenges to many stakeholders. It is a rare position to stretch your skillsets and test your abilities making real impact on the organization.

Responsibilities Include

Demonstrated ability generating, managing, and owning Integrated Master Schedules (IMS), Integrated Master Plans (IMP), and EVMS (earned value management system)
Financial responsibilities including project-level profit and loss, EAC’s, material sales forecasting, accruals, and cost account management (CAM)
Lead program execution with key subcontractors through all program phases, including SRR/PDR/CDR milestones and program management related CDRLs
Serve as a primary customer contact for material and subcontract program information
Ability to confidently present and represent Voyager Technologies Global Supply Chain in Program Management Reviews, leadership briefings, and customer briefings
Ability to creatively solve complex supply chain problems with data driven strategies
Demonstrated aptitude in identifying Risks and Opportunities to the program
Consistently work on supply and demand to proactively identify gaps to eliminate them
Escalate critical material shortages immediately upon identification and own efforts to resolve them
Ability to resolve short term problems while maintaining long term success of the program
Demonstrated ability to work in a fast paced development environment
Implement solutions to overcome current & future material shortages
Coordinate and optimize delivery schedules with critical Suppliers
Support follow-on and new business opportunities, including input into proposals
Challenge business impediments to excellence and continuous improvement
Demonstrated ability to lead others through dynamic and fluid environments

If your experience aligns with our basic qualifications and you are inspired by our mission, we’d like to connect. If you don’t see the right role right now,
Join Our Talent Community
and stay connected as we continue to build what’s next.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in engineering or business AND a minimum of twenty (20) years of program management and/or supply chain management experience, including five (5) years managing DoD propulsion related programs
Must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government issued Secret clearance; US citizenship is required
Direct experience managing large subcontracts
Material Program Management and/or Supply Chain Management experience working on prime defense programs
Experience briefing executive management and customers on program status, risks, and future plans
Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills
Strong Program and Budget Management skills
Proficient user with Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Project, Excel and PowerPoint

Preferred Qualifications

Active DoD Secret clearance
Management of rocket propulsion defense system programs, including propulsion control systems
Bachelor's degree in Systems, Aerospace, or Mechanical Engineering
Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification
Understanding of Government Procurement processes and regulations
Lean and Six Sigma Training and/or Certification desired
Experience leading and supporting prime proposal efforts and business development with funding customer offices
Expert Excel ability including pivot tables, macros, and VBA

Travel, Physical, And/or Government Mandated Requirements

Travel up to 10%, including the possibility of overnights within the United States

jobs.description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About The Role

Suno is looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager to help us scale our technical programs and launches - coordinating across engineering, product, and other functions to land some of our largest initiatives. As a Staff TPM, you’ll have the ability to create and drive programs, and partner with us to figure out where we should be investing that we aren’t today. TPM as a function is new to Suno, and there’s a real opportunity to help us build it from the ground up

What You'll Do

Lead cross-functional programs end to end — things like model launches, multi-team engineering efforts, and engineering initiatives — from scoping, through rollout, and tracking
Coach and grow the team's TPM, building the mentorship and structure that hasn't existed here before
Help shape what "TPM" means at Suno — the working model, the organizing principles, and where the function needs to grow
Partner closely with engineering leadership so cross-functional continues to move fast and collaboration is easy, contributing directly to team velocity
Help turn Suno's mission — making creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone — into shipped, coordinated reality across teams

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

8–10 years in program or technical program management
Demonstrated adaptability — you find the right approach for the environment you're in rather than importing what worked somewhere else
A clear, articulable framework for how you evaluate and measure whether a program is actually succeeding
Enough technical/coding fluency to get hands-on and understand the work that needs to be done, not just coordinate around it

Nice-to-Haves

Track record of building a program from zero in genuine ambiguity and landing it
Experience coaching or mentoring other program managers
Background at a consumer tech company, a high-scale tech company, or a hypergrowth scale-up
Experience coordinating launches for AI or ML-driven products

Work Location Policy

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Perks & Benefits For Full-Time Employees

Company Equity Package
401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)
Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)
11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time
16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave
Creative Education Stipend
Generous Commuter Allowance
In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is $230,000 - $300,000 + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)
