Strong data analysis skills including experience gathering, organizing and analyzing data, and communicating/presenting results and recommendations in a succinct fashion to key stakeholders.

new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Vendor and Scaled Operations
new_jobs.description:
Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.

About The Service Operations Team

We're a tight-knit team of program management, process & automation, and workforce management professionals working together to deliver world-class service through operational excellence and strategic enablement. We collaborate closely with frontline Service, Business Apps, QA, Enablement, and Analytics teams to plan and deliver on complex initiatives that improve processes, tools, and how our service operates day-to-day. Our focus is on creating service experiences that are both efficient for our operations team while providing an excellent experience for our customers and pros.

About The Role

As a Senior Program Manager, Vendor & Scaled Operations within Thumbtack's Service Operations PMO, you will own our outsourced and scaled delivery model - the strategy, the governance, and the long-horizon programs that determine how a meaningful share of our service gets delivered. This is not a generalist PM role. It is purpose-built for someone who can hold a commercial relationship, an operational system, and an executive narrative at the same time.

You will own Thumbtack's vendor and BPO strategy for Service Operations end to end: how we decide what to outsource, how we hold partners accountable, how we govern performance, and how we scale or unwind capacity as the business changes. You'll own a portfolio of scaled operations and partner support programs spanning a year or more, with real interdependencies between them, and you'll make the prioritization and capacity calls across that portfolio rather than escalating them.

You'll also be the person leadership turns to for the make-versus-buy conversation. Expect to build the cost, quality, and risk case for how we scale, bring it to senior leaders and to vendor executives, and then be accountable for the model you recommended.

This is a high-leverage, high-ambiguity role. Much of the infrastructure you'll need does not fully exist yet, and building it durably - so it outlasts you - is a core part of the job.

What You’ll Do

Own Thumbtack's vendor and outsourcing strategy for Service Operations - sourcing decisions, make-versus-buy recommendations, capacity strategy across internal, vendor, and partner channels, and the case for expanding, consolidating, or exiting a partner. Own the commercial relationship alongside Legal, Finance, and Procurement (SOWs, rate structures, SLA credits and remedies, renewals) and know which levers to pull when performance slips.
Design and optimize the governance model for vendor performance: SLA and scorecard architecture, QBR structure, decision rights, escalation paths, and remediation playbooks. Build durable frameworks, not one-off trackers.
Own a portfolio of programs. Set the strategy, sequence the work, decide what does and doesn't get done, drive it to business-level outcomes, and establish the operating rhythms - cadences, decision logs, dependency tracking, escalation thresholds, change communication - that keep distributed, multi-party delivery predictable.
Build the measurement framework for the scaled delivery model: quality, SLA attainment, forecast accuracy, cost-to-serve, and the leading indicators that reveal a program is silently degrading before the lagging metrics do. Define what "good" looks like and close the loop so performance data actually changes behavior - on our side and the vendor's.
Align senior leaders and lead the change. Bring executives across Service Operations, IT, Legal, Finance, Product, and Workforce Management to a decision on sourcing priorities and tradeoffs, translating tangled multi-party problems into a clear recommendation - then drive adoption through teams and partners who don't report to you, including the unglamorous follow-through that determines whether change sticks.
Raise the bar on how this work gets done. Identify and build AI and automation that reduces coordination overhead and improves oversight at scale, and coach other program managers while institutionalizing what works into playbooks and standards, so every future partnership starts from a higher floor.

In order to be successful, you must bring

8+ years in program or project management, including 3+ years owning vendor, BPO, or outsourced delivery relationships at scale. Experience with multiple vendors, multiple sites, or a vendor transition is strongly preferred. Proficiency in program management tooling (e.g., Jira, Linear, Coda, Smartsheet) and fluency across Agile and Waterfall approaches. PMP, PgMP, or equivalent is nice-to-have.
Deep vendor ownership and sourcing judgment. You've personally owned an outsourcing relationship end to end - commercial terms, governance, performance management, escalation, and the hard conversations - not just coordinated with one someone else owned. You've also built and defended a make-versus-buy or vendor expansion case with cost, quality, and risk modeling, and taken it to senior leadership.
Portfolio-level ownership. You've run multiple concurrent scale programs with genuine tradeoffs between them, and owned the prioritization and capacity calls yourself. You've run programs where consistency of human execution at volume is the product - you know how to design for repeatability, and you spot degradation from leading indicators rather than after the fact.
A track record of building durable infrastructure. SLA and scorecard architecture, governance models, transition playbooks, reporting systems - things other teams adopted and still use. You build and maintain the models, dashboards, and SLA tracking yourself rather than waiting for someone else to instrument it.
Comfort where the playbook doesn't exist, and a habit of leaving people better than you found them. You've stepped into situations with no established approach and built one, with the judgment to know when structure helps and when it would slow things down - and you've mentored program managers or been the person other teams borrow practices from.

Expected salary ranges

For candidates living in Ontario and British Columbia, the expected total cash compensation (base salary + variable pay, if applicable) range for this role is currently $102,000 - $132,000

Actual offered salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as calibrated job level, qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

We also will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable law.

new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Vendor and Scaled Operations
new_jobs.description:
Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.

About The Service Operations Team

We're a tight-knit team of program management, process & automation, and workforce management professionals working together to deliver world-class service through operational excellence and strategic enablement. We collaborate closely with frontline Service, Business Apps, QA, Enablement, and Analytics teams to plan and deliver on complex initiatives that improve processes, tools, and how our service operates day-to-day. Our focus is on creating service experiences that are both efficient for our operations team while providing an excellent experience for our customers and pros.

About The Role

As a Senior Program Manager, Vendor & Scaled Operations within Thumbtack's Service Operations PMO, you will own our outsourced and scaled delivery model - the strategy, the governance, and the long-horizon programs that determine how a meaningful share of our service gets delivered. This is not a generalist PM role. It is purpose-built for someone who can hold a commercial relationship, an operational system, and an executive narrative at the same time.

You will own Thumbtack's vendor and BPO strategy for Service Operations end to end: how we decide what to outsource, how we hold partners accountable, how we govern performance, and how we scale or unwind capacity as the business changes. You'll own a portfolio of scaled operations and partner support programs spanning a year or more, with real interdependencies between them, and you'll make the prioritization and capacity calls across that portfolio rather than escalating them.

You'll also be the person leadership turns to for the make-versus-buy conversation. Expect to build the cost, quality, and risk case for how we scale, bring it to senior leaders and to vendor executives, and then be accountable for the model you recommended.

This is a high-leverage, high-ambiguity role. Much of the infrastructure you'll need does not fully exist yet, and building it durably - so it outlasts you - is a core part of the job.

What You’ll Do

Own Thumbtack's vendor and outsourcing strategy for Service Operations - sourcing decisions, make-versus-buy recommendations, capacity strategy across internal, vendor, and partner channels, and the case for expanding, consolidating, or exiting a partner. Own the commercial relationship alongside Legal, Finance, and Procurement (SOWs, rate structures, SLA credits and remedies, renewals) and know which levers to pull when performance slips.
Design and optimize the governance model for vendor performance: SLA and scorecard architecture, QBR structure, decision rights, escalation paths, and remediation playbooks. Build durable frameworks, not one-off trackers.
Own a portfolio of programs. Set the strategy, sequence the work, decide what does and doesn't get done, drive it to business-level outcomes, and establish the operating rhythms - cadences, decision logs, dependency tracking, escalation thresholds, change communication - that keep distributed, multi-party delivery predictable.
Build the measurement framework for the scaled delivery model: quality, SLA attainment, forecast accuracy, cost-to-serve, and the leading indicators that reveal a program is silently degrading before the lagging metrics do. Define what "good" looks like and close the loop so performance data actually changes behavior - on our side and the vendor's.
Align senior leaders and lead the change. Bring executives across Service Operations, IT, Legal, Finance, Product, and Workforce Management to a decision on sourcing priorities and tradeoffs, translating tangled multi-party problems into a clear recommendation - then drive adoption through teams and partners who don't report to you, including the unglamorous follow-through that determines whether change sticks.
Raise the bar on how this work gets done. Identify and build AI and automation that reduces coordination overhead and improves oversight at scale, and coach other program managers while institutionalizing what works into playbooks and standards, so every future partnership starts from a higher floor.

In order to be successful, you must bring

8+ years in program or project management, including 3+ years owning vendor, BPO, or outsourced delivery relationships at scale. Experience with multiple vendors, multiple sites, or a vendor transition is strongly preferred. Proficiency in program management tooling (e.g., Jira, Linear, Coda, Smartsheet) and fluency across Agile and Waterfall approaches. PMP, PgMP, or equivalent is nice-to-have.
Deep vendor ownership and sourcing judgment. You've personally owned an outsourcing relationship end to end - commercial terms, governance, performance management, escalation, and the hard conversations - not just coordinated with one someone else owned. You've also built and defended a make-versus-buy or vendor expansion case with cost, quality, and risk modeling, and taken it to senior leadership.
Portfolio-level ownership. You've run multiple concurrent scale programs with genuine tradeoffs between them, and owned the prioritization and capacity calls yourself. You've run programs where consistency of human execution at volume is the product - you know how to design for repeatability, and you spot degradation from leading indicators rather than after the fact.
A track record of building durable infrastructure. SLA and scorecard architecture, governance models, transition playbooks, reporting systems - things other teams adopted and still use. You build and maintain the models, dashboards, and SLA tracking yourself rather than waiting for someone else to instrument it.
Comfort where the playbook doesn't exist, and a habit of leaving people better than you found them. You've stepped into situations with no established approach and built one, with the judgment to know when structure helps and when it would slow things down - and you've mentored program managers or been the person other teams borrow practices from.

Actual offered salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as calibrated job level, qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

Position Overview

The Enterprise Asset Program Manager is responsible for implementing, operationalizing, and owning Autodesk's enterprise hardware asset management capability across PCs, Macs, mobile phones, and other end-user hardware. The role is structured as an individual contributor today; prior experience leading people or cross-functional programs is valued for how someone approaches ownership and accountability, even without direct reports in this seat.

This role owns asset management for a global population of approximately 21,500 employees and contingent workers, covering an estimated 60,000+ devices across computers, mobile phones, and loaner and spare inventory. Asset Program Architecture and Governance

Catalog and Standards

Experience in the automotive industry

Location: Hybrid, US Based
Employment Type: Full-time
Clearance: Active TS or Active TS/SCI with CT Polygraph
Travel: 60 -70%

About Terradepth

Terradepth is building the next generation of ocean technology by combining autonomous maritime hardware, software, data, and AI into an integrated Ocean Operating System. We work with government and commercial customers to solve complex problems in some of the world's most challenging environments.

The Role

We are looking for a Project Manager with 5–10 years of progressively responsible experience managing government programs and contracts. This person will manage multiple concurrent projects and serve as the connective tissue between our customers and internal Engineering, Product, Operations, Sales, and Finance teams.
The ideal candidate understands both the discipline required to execute federal contracts and the speed and flexibility required in a growing technology company. Experience with enterprise SaaS, maritime systems, defense technology, or complex hardware/software programs is highly desirable.
This is a hands-on role. You will be expected to own schedules, deliverables, customer communication, risks, budgets, and execution—not simply coordinate meetings.

Key Responsibilities

Manage multiple government and commercial projects from contract award through delivery, customer acceptance, invoicing support and closeout.
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, budgets, deliverables, and resource requirements.
Serve as the primary day-to-day program interface for assigned customers and build trusted relationships with technical, operational, contracting, and program stakeholders.
Actively develop and maintain customer relationships during project execution.
Translate contractual requirements into clear internal tasks, priorities, and deliverables.
Coordinate across Software Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Product, Operations, Sales, and Finance.
Track contractual deliverables including reporting requirements, invoicing milestones, project performance, risks, dependencies, issues, and corrective actions.
Maintain scope and change control by documenting customer requests, assessing their impact, and coordinating contract modifications when required.
Lead regular internal and customer project reviews.
Ensure contractual commitments and customer expectations are clearly understood and actively managed.
Support proposals, contract modifications, SOW development, and new business opportunities.
Identify project risks early and drive resolution rather than simply reporting problems.
Identify additional sales and technical opportunities within the project and relay to appropriate internal Terradepth personnel for further development.
Maintain appropriate program documentation and reporting for government customers.
Support customer demonstrations, testing, deployments, and operational activities as required.
Travel to customer and field sites as required.

What We're Looking For

5–10 years of progressive project/program management experience, preferably supporting federal government contracts.
At minimum, active TS or active TS/SCI with Polygraph required.
Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects or programs simultaneously.
Strong understanding of federal contracting, government customer expectations, and contract execution.
Experience managing technical programs involving software, hardware, data, or integrated systems.
Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS business models and software product delivery.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work effectively with engineers, executives, customers, and government stakeholders.
Highly organized, accountable, and comfortable operating with ambiguity.
Ability to identify what needs to happen next and drive the team toward completion without requiring constant direction.
Willingness to travel to customer sites and field operations as required.

Preferred Experience

Maritime, UUV/AUV, robotics, defense, ocean technology, or related industry experience.
Experience with DoD, IC, or other federal customers.
Experience managing programs involving both physical hardware and SaaS/software platforms.
Experience working with subcontractors, technology partners, and geographically distributed teams.
Experience with JIRA, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or comparable planning and execution tools.
Experience in a startup or high-growth technology company.
PMP or similar project/program management certification.

What Success Looks Like

Projects are delivered on time, on budget, and to customer expectations.
Internal teams have clear priorities, owners, and deadlines.
Customer commitments and contractual requirements are translated into executable internal plans, and program forecasts remain current.
Customers have confidence that Terradepth understands and will deliver against its commitments.
Risks and issues are surfaced early and actively resolved.
Multiple complex programs can move forward simultaneously without losing accountability or execution discipline.

This is a role for a project manager who wants to own outcomes, not just manage schedules. You should be comfortable operating between government customers, technical teams, and company leadership and bringing structure, urgency, and accountability to complex programs.

new_jobs.description:
Voyager is an innovative space, defense, and national security technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space.

Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart.

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality.

If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager
.

The Material Program Manager (level 5
) is responsible and accountable for the execution of material schedule and budget for Voyager Technologies, including program execution with key propulsion subcontractors. The MPM leads all phases of subcontract program execution. This includes developing supplier program management documentation such as monthly status reports, SRR/PDR/CDR materials, program planning documentation, and program management related CDRLs, and presenting subcontract program materials to technical teams, leadership, and customers. The Material Program Manager (MPM) is a unique position that requires strategic thinking as well as tactical execution allowing an individual to make immediate tangible impacts. A successful MPM can work with minimal supervision to solve complex problems to ensure both short term and long term success of their respective program. An MPM would need to possess strong hard skills to execute plans to completion, as well as soft skills to appropriately work with multiple disciplines, and communicate challenges to many stakeholders. It is a rare position to stretch your skillsets and test your abilities making real impact on the organization.

Responsibilities Include

Demonstrated ability generating, managing, and owning Integrated Master Schedules (IMS), Integrated Master Plans (IMP), and EVMS (earned value management system)
Financial responsibilities including project-level profit and loss, EAC’s, material sales forecasting, accruals, and cost account management (CAM)
Lead program execution with key subcontractors through all program phases, including SRR/PDR/CDR milestones and program management related CDRLs
Serve as a primary customer contact for material and subcontract program information
Ability to confidently present and represent Voyager Technologies Global Supply Chain in Program Management Reviews, leadership briefings, and customer briefings
Ability to creatively solve complex supply chain problems with data driven strategies
Demonstrated aptitude in identifying Risks and Opportunities to the program
Consistently work on supply and demand to proactively identify gaps to eliminate them
Escalate critical material shortages immediately upon identification and own efforts to resolve them
Ability to resolve short term problems while maintaining long term success of the program
Demonstrated ability to work in a fast paced development environment
Implement solutions to overcome current & future material shortages
Coordinate and optimize delivery schedules with critical Suppliers
Support follow-on and new business opportunities, including input into proposals
Challenge business impediments to excellence and continuous improvement
Demonstrated ability to lead others through dynamic and fluid environments

If your experience aligns with our basic qualifications and you are inspired by our mission, we’d like to connect. If you don’t see the right role right now,
Join Our Talent Community
and stay connected as we continue to build what’s next.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in engineering or business AND a minimum of twenty (20) years of program management and/or supply chain management experience, including five (5) years managing DoD propulsion related programs
Must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government issued Secret clearance; US citizenship is required
Direct experience managing large subcontracts
Material Program Management and/or Supply Chain Management experience working on prime defense programs
Experience briefing executive management and customers on program status, risks, and future plans
Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills
Strong Program and Budget Management skills
Proficient user with Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Project, Excel and PowerPoint

Preferred Qualifications

Active DoD Secret clearance
Management of rocket propulsion defense system programs, including propulsion control systems
Bachelor's degree in Systems, Aerospace, or Mechanical Engineering
Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification
Understanding of Government Procurement processes and regulations
Lean and Six Sigma Training and/or Certification desired
Experience leading and supporting prime proposal efforts and business development with funding customer offices
Expert Excel ability including pivot tables, macros, and VBA

Travel, Physical, And/or Government Mandated Requirements

Travel up to 10%, including the possibility of overnights within the United States

The good faith base salary range for this role is $140,000-$195,000 at the time of this posting. Where you fall within the range depends on your experience, skills, and location. This range reflects base salary only and does not include benefits or bonus/incentive. This range may be adjusted in the future.

Voyager offers a highly competitive total compensation package designed to support the well-being, growth, and success of our employees. Employees benefit from a flexible and comprehensive rewards program that supports both professional and personal well-being.

Flexible Time Off (FTO), empowering employees to take the time they need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their families, with a significant portion of premiums covered by the company and many benefits paid at 100% for employees
Flexible, affordable gym memberships with 12,700+ options nationwide, including 24 Hour Fitness, EoS Fitness, Crunch Fitness, Anytime Fitness, Blink Fitness, Chuze Fitness, and more! No long-term contracts and FREE on-demand workout videos before you enroll
401(k) retirement plan with a 50% company match on contributions up to 8%, supporting long-term financial security
Company wellness programs that support physical and mental well-being
Additional voluntary benefits and employee support resources
The opportunity to work alongside a highly talented team in an innovative, mission-driven environment

Job Description:

We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager
to join our dynamic team within Enterprise Network Services. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in global enterprise infrastructure programs spanning network, compute, data centers, cloud, trading infrastructure, operational resilience, and technology risk
and a proven ability to stand up program charters and governance from ambiguous objectives and deliver measurable outcomes across multi-million-dollar, multi-workstream initiatives
.

Responsibilities:

Lead large, complex, multi-million-dollar infrastructure programs from charter through implementation and closure.
Develop charters, scope, objectives, success criteria, roadmaps, milestones, governance, RACI, KPIs/KRIs, and execution plans.
Manage integrated workstreams across Network, Compute, Cloud, Data Centers, Trading Infrastructure, Engineering, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Risk, Operations, Finance, Procurement, and vendors.
Own integrated plans, critical paths, dependencies, RAID, change control, and executive escalations.
Manage program budgets, forecasts, actuals, resource plans, and financial variances.
Identify technical, operational, financial, and organizational risks and drive mitigation and resolution.
Lead executive steering committees and deliver concise, decision-oriented reports to senior management.
Translate complex technical issues into clear business impact, options, recommendations, and decisions.
Influence cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders without direct authority while fostering accountability.
Build strong partnerships across global teams and promote transparency, ownership, and disciplined execution.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.
10+ years in technical program or project management, including 5+ years leading enterprise-scale network or infrastructure programs.
Proven delivery of multi-million-dollar, multi-workstream programs in complex global organizations with minimal ramp-up time.
Demonstrated ability to originate programs from concept and author charters, business cases, and funding requests.
Deep knowledge of enterprise networks, data centers, enterprise compute, and cloud connectivity.
Expert-level Jira, strong Power BI or equivalent reporting, and Confluence for documentation and knowledge management.
Exceptional written and verbal communication with experience presenting to and influencing senior executives.
Strong command of Agile, Scrum, and waterfall methodologies with the judgment to apply each appropriately.
Financial management expertise including forecasting, governance, and resource planning.
Technical aptitude to challenge assumptions and engage credibly with engineers and architects.
Must be based in or able to commute to New York, NY with on-site presence per hybrid policy.

Preferred Skills:

Financial Services or Capital Markets experience, including mission-critical or high-availability trading environments.
Experience with global infrastructure transformation, cloud adoption, network modernization, data center migration or consolidation, or technology resiliency programs.
Background in highly regulated and risk-controlled environments.
Relevant certifications such as PMP, Agile, ITIL, SAFe, Cisco (CCNA/CCNP), CISSP, or Cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP).

Key Relationships:

The role requires close collaboration with representatives from Critical Infrastructure, SETI, Corporate Services and Security, Reengineering and Expense Management, MS Real Estate, MS IT Groups, and external vendors. The individual must be able to develop and maintain effective working relationships across regions and time zones.

Benefits:

TSR Consulting offers all eligible employees a comprehensive benefits package including, but not limited to major medical, HSA, dental, vision, employer provided group life, voluntary life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, and 401k.

Through a disciplined approach to sourcing, candidate vetting, and delivery, TSR helps organizations scale teams quickly while maintaining quality and reliability.

new_jobs.title: Integrity Product Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Meta is looking for a dynamic Program Manager to join the Integrity Product Program Management team. The Integrity Product Program Management team is responsible for building, driving, and scaling processes in service of product goals that uphold our integrity mission - to protect the community at scale, with legitimacy. As a program manager on this function, you will lead programs driving goals across integrity.The ideal Program Manager is someone who has knowledge or expertise in running large-scale programs, rapidly building cross-functional relationships, and risk management. They will be key partners in helping to ensure we have effective risk management capabilities so we are able to understand and mitigate threats to our users today and prepare for those tomorrow.Specifically, the Integrity Product Program Management team will: (1) Evaluate existing and future product problem spaces through a comprehensive Meta lens, auditing similar problems in multiple places, to ensure that integrity solution development is universal and de-duplicated. (2) Build playbooks and process channels to help the integrity product scale across Facebook and the multiple ever-expanding dimensions with minimal friction for partner teams. Connect dots by understanding and auditing where people are solving the same or similar problems in different places and eliminating duplication. (3) Drive playbook adoption and application to hit clear quantifiable Meta-wide integrity product goals, mitigating risk. (4) Scale product by constantly driving efficiencies (e.g. reduce overhead, increase speed to execute).

Integrity Product Program Manager Responsibilities:

Responsible for managing multiple integrity programs using agile best practices. This includes planning, coordinating with cross-functional teams and leadership, tracking status and reporting, providing updates to the project team and key stakeholders, and creating the appropriate program documents and executive communications
Evaluate existing and future problem spaces through a comprehensive Meta lens, auditing similar problems in multiple places, to ensure Cross-Meta Integrity solution development is universal and de-duplicated
Build playbooks and process channels to help Integrity product scale across Meta and the multiple ever-expanding dimensions with minimal friction for partner teams
Drive standardized playbooks for identifying and closing gaps for integrity experiences for new products and users
Scale playbooks by constantly driving efficiencies (e.g. reduce overhead, increase speed to execute)
Develop Meta-wide playbooks for launching integrity levers both during crisis (crisis interventions, etc.) and steady state
Build close relationships with other highly cross-functional teams within Meta including, but not limited to, integrity, Family of Apps, Monetization, and Global Operations
Engage with cross-Meta teams ready to scale and mature capabilities on company-wide initiatives and governance
Demonstrate understanding of the supported Integrity product domain by conducting analyses, presenting findings, and informing product decisions, design measurement methodology, and conduct a deep analysis of the problem space
Select appropriate integrity metrics to measure the success of the program and highlight trends or themes from raw data
Evaluate existing and future product problem spaces through a comprehensive Meta lens, auditing similar problems in multiple places, to ensure integrity solution development is universal and de-duplicated

Minimum Qualifications:

8+ years experience in program or project management supporting product development
Integrity experience in user safety, trust and safety, product inception, or scalability
Experience with product development methodologies, including agile and product execution
Experience evaluating data to understand trends and support decision making
Experience driving alignment amongst a wide stakeholder base, including leadership, peers, technical, and non-technical stakeholders
Experience identifying root causes of complex issues, developing solutions, and driving resolution across cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualifications:

Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
Product Development related project management certifications (e.g. Project Management Professional or Certified Scrum Master)
Track record of operating independently, developing novel approaches to solve ambiguous problems, being detail-oriented, and delivering results at a large scale

About Meta:

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

new_jobs.description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About The Role

Suno is looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager to help us scale our technical programs and launches - coordinating across engineering, product, and other functions to land some of our largest initiatives. As a Staff TPM, you’ll have the ability to create and drive programs, and partner with us to figure out where we should be investing that we aren’t today. TPM as a function is new to Suno, and there’s a real opportunity to help us build it from the ground up

What You'll Do

Lead cross-functional programs end to end — things like model launches, multi-team engineering efforts, and engineering initiatives — from scoping, through rollout, and tracking
Coach and grow the team's TPM, building the mentorship and structure that hasn't existed here before
Help shape what "TPM" means at Suno — the working model, the organizing principles, and where the function needs to grow
Partner closely with engineering leadership so cross-functional continues to move fast and collaboration is easy, contributing directly to team velocity
Help turn Suno's mission — making creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone — into shipped, coordinated reality across teams

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

8–10 years in program or technical program management
Demonstrated adaptability — you find the right approach for the environment you're in rather than importing what worked somewhere else
A clear, articulable framework for how you evaluate and measure whether a program is actually succeeding
Enough technical/coding fluency to get hands-on and understand the work that needs to be done, not just coordinate around it

Nice-to-Haves

Track record of building a program from zero in genuine ambiguity and landing it
Experience coaching or mentoring other program managers
Background at a consumer tech company, a high-scale tech company, or a hypergrowth scale-up
Experience coordinating launches for AI or ML-driven products

Work Location Policy

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Perks & Benefits For Full-Time Employees

Company Equity Package
401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)
Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)
11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time
16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave
Creative Education Stipend
Generous Commuter Allowance
In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is $230,000 - $300,000 + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. new_jobs.title: Staff Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Company Overview

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. Our technology helps our customers solve their toughest challenges by enabling them to make better, more informed decisions in life-and-death situations. We’ve assembled a diverse team of experts in artificial intelligence, computer vision, sensor fusion, optics, and data analysis that are creating software and hardware solutions to radically evolve the capabilities of the United States and our allies. If you are passionate about solving problems that have real impact, come join Anduril and build the future of defense.

Team Overview

The Deployments / Sustainment team is responsible for fielding Anduril’s products to customers. Our core functions span everything from logistics and field operations to product operations and training. This includes site installation, product observability, incident triage, maintenance and repairs, user training, and technical documentation. We work within a broader ecosystem that includes many functional teams across business lines, including Program Management, Engineering, Mission Operations, and Deployments. This team is a crucial component of ensuring customer and mission success, and plays a critical role in shaping how Anduril continues to execute its mission of providing cutting-edge capabilities to the United States and its allies.

Role Specifics

As a Program Manager on the Sustainment team, your mission is to spearhead large-scale, high-impact projects and initiatives from cradle to grave. You will be responsible for taking ambiguous, undefined problems and providing structure and extreme ownership from definition, to solution, and implementation. You will work across various sustainment functions including Product Operations, Training, and Deployments. You should have an aptitude for working with senior leaders across diverse stakeholder groups to achieve strategic objectives. If you are passionate about ground-breaking technology, contributing to the national security missions, interacting alongside professionals that span a wide-range of disciplines, and executing high-leverage strategic initiatives, then Anduril is interested in speaking with you.

What You’ll Do

Manage delivery and implementation of software tooling for Sustainment capabilities across the enterprise
Take extreme ownership of projects, from definition, to solution and implementation. You will be handed ambiguous, messy problems with little prescription on how to solve them. If this does not excite you, this is not the role for you.
Work on strategic problems, providing structure and shepherding cross-functional groups of stakeholders towards decisions on strategic issues. You will leverage critical thinking to detail implications and tradeoffs of decisions without losing sight of the simple “so what”
Identify organizational gaps and problems through an intimate, tactical-level understanding of the team’s operations, then build consensus and resources to solve these gaps
Weaponize the large amounts of data collected to create insights that drive business decisions
Execute ad hoc projects with internal and cross-functional teams to support critical operational and financial decision making.

Required Qualifications

Demonstrated experience as a self-starter, able to find and resolve issues on your own. Don’t wait to be told what to do - we want someone who we have to tell to slow down.
Extreme ownership and strong aptitude for problem solving in unstructured situations - analysis, developing a solution plan, and executing.

As we continue to grow at a rapid pace, we are looking for skilled talent to join our team. If you believe this opportunity is right for you, we welcome you to apply today!

Job Summary

The IT Security Manager is a hands-on cybersecurity professional responsible for protecting Miller Industries’ cloud and on-premises environments, administering security controls and major-system access, and maintaining the organization’s security compliance program. This position performs day-to-day security work directly while providing experienced leadership across identity and access management, vulnerability and risk reduction, monitoring, incident response, policy governance, and security documentation.

The role reports to the Director of IT and serves as the primary internal owner for information security. The IT Security Manager coordinates external security vendors and contracted security resources, partners with technology and business teams to implement practical controls and is expected to help build the security function over time, including the potential future supervision and development of a Security Analyst.

Main Duties & Responsibilities

Own and perform day-to-day security administration across Microsoft 365, Azure, endpoints, servers, networks, applications, and other cloud and on-premises technology environments.
Administer and continuously improve identity and access controls, including privileged access, role-based access, multifactor authentication, conditional access, least privilege, and periodic access reviews.
Serve as the security and permissions owner for major business systems, including GSS, Procore, and Microsoft platforms, coordinating approvals, provisioning, changes, reviews, and removal of access with system owners.
Monitor security events and findings; investigate alerts; coordinate containment, remediation, recovery, and lessons learned; and maintain incident response procedures and evidence.

Are you ready to help CalSAWS strengthen enterprise security and protect sensitive data across one of the nation’s largest public-sector technology environments?

If so, CalSAWS invites you to apply today to join our team as the next Security Manager – Security Architecture & Data Protection!

POSITION INFORMATION

The Security Manager – Security Architecture & Data Protection reports to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and plays a critical role in strengthening the CalSAWS enterprise security program by ensuring security is incorporated into technology, applications, data, and business processes from the start.

This position leads security architecture reviews for new and changing technologies, evaluates security risks and design decisions, and establishes effective controls to protect sensitive information. The California Statewide Automated Welfare System (CalSAWS) is the largest county-based human services system in the nation. In June 2019, all fifty-eight California counties formed the CalSAWS Consortium as a Joint Powers Authority (JPA) to govern system operations and represent the collective interests of every county.

As of October 2023, CalSAWS successfully unified all counties into a single statewide system. CalSAWS is now in its Maintenance and Operations (M&O) phase, ensuring reliable, secure, and efficient system functionality for millions of Californians.

This role represents a critical opportunity to improve enterprise alignment upstream of delivery, helping CalSAWS reduce downstream friction, improve coordination, and support more cohesive customer and workforce experiences statewide.

At least two (2) years of experience must have been in a supervisory capacity.

Hands-on experience performing security architecture and design reviews for complex enterprise systems
Experience with data protection-by-design, AI/ML systems, input/output monitoring, data residency enforcement, and access controls

Experience managing structured workflows involving intake, triage, documentation tracking, and closure across multiple stakeholders

CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CCSP, CDPSE, CIPM, or equivalent security certifications
GIAC certifications
Security+ or equivalent
Cloud security certifications
AWS Security Architect or equivalent

All positions may be subject to some short-term travel in order to conduct project business with the state and counties. The CalSAWS project office is currently located in Gold River, California.

new_jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
Operations · Compliance · Finance · San Francisco, CA
Full-Time · Occasional Travel (conferences & agency events)

WHO IS ABEL?

Abel is the AI toolkit for law enforcement — purpose-built to give officers their time back. Our platform includes Abel Writer, which turns body camera footage and officer-provided material into completed police reports; Abel Chat, a CJIS-compliant assistant grounded in agency policy manuals and state code that answers with cited sources; Abel Translate, live in-field translation across 83 languages; and Abel Citizen, an online reporting portal where resident-filed reports arrive clean, translated, and NIBRS-ready.

Patrol officers spend roughly one-third of every shift writing reports. Abel gives that time back — and agencies describe it as a need-to-have, not a nice-to-have.

Backed by Y Combinator and deployed at agencies nationwide, Abel is growing fast. Selling AI to government comes with procurement, compliance, and contracting work most startups never see — which makes operations a competitive advantage here, not a back office.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Abel is hiring a Business Operations Manager to own the operating backbone of the company. You will run everything that keeps a B2G company moving: government procurement responses, contracts, CJIS compliance coordination, finance, people ops, and the internal systems that hold it all together.

You will work directly with the CEO and a small senior team, and you will inherit a documented, systematized ops function: written runbooks, filing conventions, and an AI-assisted toolchain that already automates quotes, customer agreements, pilot agreements, and sales decks. Your job is to run it, improve it, and keep the company fast as it grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own government procurement end-to-end: RFP/RFQ/RFI responses, vendor-pool registrations, portal submissions, and customer reference coordination
Run the contract pipeline: quotes, pilot agreements, information sharing agreements, MSAs, and reseller agreements, including routing to outside counsel and the CEO
Coordinate compliance operations: CJIS requirements, security questionnaires, and customer security requests, working with our CTO and in Vanta regularly
Manage finance operations: invoicing, payroll, multi-state registrations and tax obligations, and vendor/software spend
Own people ops: hiring logistics, onboarding and offboarding, benefits administration, and employment compliance
Support sales operations: CRM hygiene, quote generation, agency document filing, and conference/event logistics
Operate and extend our AI-assisted ops toolchain: the templates, scripts, and automations that turn repeat work into one-command workflows
Help CEO stay focused on urgent legal, finance, customer, and hiring matters, and flag risks early, with a practical fix attached
Keep office organized and stocked, ordering new supplies and managing on site vendors as needed

YOUR FIRST 45 DAYS

Abel is a results-oriented culture. We use 45-day plans because good days lead to good weeks, which lead to good months. Here's what to expect:

Days 1–15: Learn

Complete a structured handoff of every active workstream: contracts in flight, the conference calendar, procurement deadlines, and vendor relationships
Take over recurring cadences: expense management, invoicing, renewals tracking, and account administration
Learn the Abel product suite and the B2G sales motion from pilot to renewal

Days 15–30: Own

Run an active government procurement response end-to-end
Own the contract and quote workflows, including our document automation tools
Take over day-to-day relationships with outside counsel, accountants, and our security vendor

Days 31–45: Improve

Run the full operations calendar independently
Ship at least one process improvement that saves the team real time
Present an ops roadmap to the CEO: risks, gaps, and what to systematize next

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

4+ years in startup operations, business operations, legal ops, chief of staff, or a similar role
Meticulous with contracts, government paperwork, and compliance detail — small errors have real consequences in our market
Strong judgment and discretion with sensitive legal, employee, and customer information
Excellent project management: many moving pieces, hard external deadlines, nothing dropped
Comfort using AI tools daily — you automate repeat work rather than grinding through it
Experience working directly with founders or executives in a high-context, fast-changing environment
Strong written communication; you turn ambiguity into clear next steps
High ownership: if something is broken, unclear, or risky, you fix it without being asked

NICE TO HAVE

Experience in B2G, GovTech, public safety, or another regulated market
Familiarity with CJIS, SOC 2, security questionnaires, or public-sector procurement
Fluency with our stack: Google Workspace, HubSpot, Slack, 1Password, DocuSign, Brex, Carta — plus the AI assistants we wire into all of them

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Competitive salary and meaningful equity — every Abel employee is an owner
Comprehensive medical and dental coverage
Flexible PTO — we trust our team to manage their time

HOW WE HIRE

We respect your time and move with urgency. Here's our process:
Intro Call — A conversation with our operations lead about your background, what you're looking for, and a candid view of the role.
CEO Interview — A deep dive with our founder on the work, expectations, and how we operate.
Practical Exercise — A short, realistic ops scenario: contract review, a procurement question, or process design.
Team Conversations — Meet the people you'll work with every day.

FRAUD NOTICE

We do not make job offers through messaging apps, social platforms, or unauthorized third parties, and we will never request payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you receive suspicious outreach claiming to be from Abel, contact us at careers@abelpolice.com.

new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Bobyard

Construction is a trillion dollar industry running on manual work. Contractors still measure and count materials off drawings by hand — it takes forever. Bobyard uses AI to automate takeoffs and estimates, making bids 10x faster. We're Series A, backed by 8VC, Primary, and Pear, and we're shipping faster than most teams can track.

About The Role

The product team is launching new trades, features, and fixes constantly — sometimes a dozen projects in flight at once. Right now, nobody owns making sure what ships is actually fixed, actually launched, and actually communicated. That's this role. You'll sit between engineering and every customer-facing team, verify that bugs are really resolved before we tell anyone they're fixed, and make sure every launch comes with a clear, honest update to the people who need it — customers, CSMs, and sales alike.

What You'll Do

Own the day-to-day truth of Linear — every ticket has a real status, nothing goes stale or slips silently past its target date
Independently verify that "fixed" tickets are actually fixed before they're closed or communicated
Write and send launch communications for every release — clear, specific, no corporate filler — to customers and internal teams
Build and run a standard launch checklist so marketing and CS are looped in before a release, not briefed after
Coordinate directly with Platform engineers on active projects — you're in their tickets, not waiting on a summary
Flag risk and slippage early, in the same weekly rhythm the product team already runs
Be the first call when a customer says something's broken and an engineer says it isn't

What We're Looking For

2–5 years in a role that combined technical coordination with customer-facing communication — Implementation, CS Ops, QA, or release coordination
Fluent in Linear or Jira — daily use, not passing familiarity
Can write the same update two ways: technical for engineers, plain for customers
Comfortable pushing back on an engineer's "it's fixed" claim without making it a fight
Genuinely enjoys verification and follow-through — you don't lose interest once something's "probably done"
Based in or willing to relocate to San Francisco

Nice to Have

Experience at a Series A–C startup with no dedicated QA team
Background in construction tech, PropTech, or a technical B2B product
Experience building a launch or release process from scratch

What We Offer

$120,000–$150,000 base salary, plus 0.02%–0.04% equity (4-year vest, 1-year cliff). Based in San Francisco, on-site with the team at 101 2nd Street.

Comp Philosophy

We are proud to offer competitive, top-of-market compensation because we want to celebrate the dedicated people who ship amazing work and drive our success. Our individual compensation is thoughtfully tailored based on your role, experience, and contributions, alongside performance-based rewards.

Compensation Range: $140K - $160K

new_jobs.title: Search Intelligence Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD98619

L'affichage de poste en français suivra / The French job posting follows.

26WD98619, Search Intelligence Manager

Position Overview

We’re looking for a curious, analytical, and technically fluent Search Intelligence Manager to help Autodesk understand how customers discover, explore, and convert across traditional organic search and emerging AI-driven discovery experiences.

This role supports the broader Search Experience function by turning search, website, content, and customer behavior data into trusted dashboards, clear insights, and actionable recommendations. You’ll work with backend data systems, BI tools, Streamlit dashboards, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Snowflake, and other reporting sources to help teams understand what is changing, why it matters, and where to act next.

This is a data and insights role with a search lens. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with data systems and reporting tools, curious about customer behavior, and excited to learn and shape how search, content, and AI-driven discovery shape the journey from discovery to conversion.

Responsibilities

Build and improve dashboards for search visibility, website engagement, content performance, customer journeys, and conversion trends
Work with backend data systems, BI tools, Streamlit, Google Search Console, SEMrush, and other sources to collect, validate, analyze, and visualize performance data
Diagnose search and discovery trends across impressions, clicks, CTR, rankings, landing pages, engagement, conversion, AI referrals, and emerging LLM-driven discovery paths
Analyze behavioral patterns for users arriving through organic search and AI-driven discovery, including landing-page behavior, content paths, drop-off points, and conversion signals
Identify SEO, AEO, content, and digital experience optimization opportunities based on data, customer behavior, and business impact
Partner with analytics, data engineering, search, content, marketing, and technical teams to define KPI logic, reporting needs, and source-of-truth measurement approaches
QA datasets, dashboards, reporting outputs, and scoring frameworks to ensure accuracy, consistency, and stakeholder trust
Support prioritization by combining performance data, business value, customer intent, content metadata, and optimization opportunity
Prepare concise performance summaries, visualizations, and insight narratives that help teams make smarter decisions
Stay current on search behavior, AI-driven discovery, analytics practices, and emerging measurement approaches

Minimum Qualifications

3–5+ years of experience in digital analytics, marketing analytics, BI/reporting, analytics engineering, growth analytics, search analytics, or a related analytical role
Experience working with backend data systems, data warehouses, BI platforms, dashboards, and large datasets
Strong SQL or equivalent data-querying experience, with the ability to pull, join, clean, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources
Experience building dashboards, reporting tools, or lightweight data applications using tools such as Streamlit, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms
Familiarity with Google Search Console and SEMrush data, including search visibility, query, landing-page, and keyword performance trends
Ability to analyze customer behavior, journey paths, funnel performance, or conversion patterns using web analytics, BI tools, or backend datasets
Strong data QA skills, including validating metric definitions, identifying discrepancies, documenting assumptions, and ensuring reporting accuracy
Ability to translate complex data into clear insights, recommendations, and business narratives
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn quickly in a fast-moving search and AI discovery landscape
Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across analytics, data engineering, search, content, marketing, and technical teams

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with SEO concepts, keyword strategy, content performance, search visibility, or digital marketing metrics
Familiarity with AEO or AI-driven search concepts such as AI Overviews, LLM referrals, prompt monitoring, citation visibility, share of answer, or zero-click behavior
Experience with Python, R, dbt, BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, ETL workflows, data modeling, or analytics engineering practices
Experience combining search data, web analytics data, content metadata, CRM/conversion data, and customer behavior data to generate recommendations
Experience developing KPI frameworks, prioritization models, scoring systems, or source-of-truth reporting documentation
Experience with Adobe Analytics or similar web analytics platforms

26WD98619, Responsable de l'intelligence de recherche

Aperçu du Poste

Nous recherchons un responsable de l’intelligence de recherche (Search Intelligence Manager) doté d’un esprit curieux, d’un esprit analytique et de solides compétences techniques, afin d’aider Autodesk à comprendre comment les clients découvrent, explorent et effectuent des conversions, tant via la recherche organique traditionnelle que via les nouvelles expériences de découverte basées sur l’IA.

Ce poste soutient la fonction « Search Experience » au sens large en transformant les données relatives à la recherche, au site web, au contenu et au comportement des clients en tableaux de bord fiables, en informations claires et en recommandations exploitables. Vous travaillerez avec des systèmes de données backend, des outils de BI, des tableaux de bord Streamlit, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Snowflake et d’autres sources de reporting afin d’aider les équipes à comprendre ce qui évolue, pourquoi cela est important et quelles actions entreprendre ensuite.

Il s’agit d’un poste axé sur les données et les analyses, avec une approche centrée sur la recherche. Le candidat idéal est à l’aise avec les systèmes de données et les outils de reporting, fait preuve de curiosité vis-à-vis du comportement des clients et est enthousiaste à l’idée d’apprendre et de contribuer à façonner la manière dont la recherche, le contenu et la découverte pilotée par l’IA influencent le parcours client, de la découverte à la conversion.

Responsabilités

Créer et améliorer des tableaux de bord sur la visibilité en recherche, l’engagement sur le site web, les performances du contenu, les parcours clients et les tendances de conversion
Utiliser les systèmes de données back-end, les outils de BI, Streamlit, Google Search Console, SEMrush et d’autres sources pour collecter, valider, analyser et visualiser les données de performance
Analyser les tendances en matière de recherche et de découverte à travers les impressions, les clics, le CTR, les classements, les pages de destination, l’engagement, la conversion, les références issues de l’IA et les nouveaux parcours de découverte pilotés par les modèles de langage (LLM)
Analyser les modèles de comportement des utilisateurs arrivant via le référencement naturel et la découverte pilotée par l’IA, notamment le comportement sur les pages de destination, les parcours de contenu, les points d’abandon et les signaux de conversion
Identifier les opportunités d’optimisation en matière de référencement naturel (SEO), de référencement sur les moteurs de recherche (AEO), de contenu et d’expérience numérique en s’appuyant sur les données, le comportement des clients et l’impact commercial
Collaborer avec les équipes d’analyse, d’ingénierie des données, de référencement, de contenu, de marketing et techniques pour définir la logique des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI), les besoins en matière de reporting et les approches de mesure basées sur une « source de vérité »
Assurer la qualité des ensembles de données, des tableaux de bord, des rapports et des cadres de notation afin de garantir l’exactitude, la cohérence et la confiance des parties prenantes
Soutenir la hiérarchisation des priorités en combinant les données de performance, la valeur métier, l’intention client, les métadonnées de contenu et les opportunités d’optimisation
Préparer des résumés de performance concis, des visualisations et des analyses qui aident les équipes à prendre des décisions plus éclairées
Se tenir informé des dernières évolutions en matière de comportement de recherche, de découverte pilotée par l’IA, de pratiques analytiques et d’approches de mesure émergentes

Qualifications Minimales

3 à 5 ans ou plus d’expérience en analyse numérique, analyse marketing, BI/reporting, ingénierie analytique, analyse de croissance, analyse de recherche ou dans un poste analytique connexe
Expérience de travail avec des systèmes de données backend, des entrepôts de données, des plateformes BI, des tableaux de bord et des ensembles de données volumineux
Solide expérience en SQL ou en langage équivalent pour l’interrogation de données, avec la capacité d’extraire, de joindre, de nettoyer, de valider et d’analyser des données provenant de sources multiples
Expérience dans la création de tableaux de bord, d’outils de reporting ou d’applications de données légères à l’aide d’outils tels que Streamlit, Looker, Tableau, Power BI ou des plateformes similaires
Maîtrise des données de Google Search Console et de SEMrush, notamment en matière de visibilité dans les résultats de recherche, de requêtes, de pages de destination et de tendances de performance des mots-clés
Capacité à analyser le comportement des clients, les parcours clients, les performances des entonnoirs de conversion ou les modèles de conversion à l’aide de l’analyse Web, d’outils de BI ou d’ensembles de données back-end
Solides compétences en assurance qualité des données, notamment pour valider les définitions des indicateurs, identifier les divergences, documenter les hypothèses et garantir l’exactitude des rapports
Capacité à traduire des données complexes en informations claires, en recommandations et en récits métier
Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes, souci du détail et volonté d’apprendre rapidement dans un environnement en constante évolution, notamment en matière de recherche et de découverte par IA
Esprit de collaboration et capacité à travailler avec les équipes d’analyse, d’ingénierie des données, de recherche, de contenu, de marketing et techniques

Qualifications Souhaitées

Connaissance des concepts de référencement naturel (SEO), de stratégie de mots-clés, de performance du contenu, de visibilité dans les résultats de recherche ou d’indicateurs de marketing numérique
Connaissance des concepts liés à l’AEO ou à la recherche basée sur l’IA, tels que les descriptions IA, les renvois LLM, la surveillance des prompts, la visibilité des citations, la part de réponse ou le comportement « zéro clic »
Expérience avec Python, R, dbt, BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, les workflows ETL, la modélisation des données ou les pratiques d’ingénierie analytique
Expérience dans la combinaison de données de recherche, de données d’analyse web, de métadonnées de contenu, de données CRM/de conversion et de données sur le comportement client pour générer des recommandations
Expérience dans le développement de cadres de KPI, de modèles de priorisation, de systèmes de notation ou de documentation de reporting « source of truth »
Expérience avec Adobe Analytics ou des plateformes d’analyse web similaires

Learn More

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

Position Overview:

Our client, a $3B professional services organization, is seeking a Competitive Intelligence Analyst to join its Business Development Department and serve as a research and market monitoring resource for select practice areas. Partnering with business development colleagues and professionals across the firm's business departments, the analyst will keep a close watch on clients, prospects and the broader market, delivering insights that uncover new business opportunities and deepen client relationships. Success in this role calls for intellectual curiosity, sharp analytical judgment and a collaborative mindset.

Key Responsibilities:

Carry out competitive intelligence and market research across companies and industries to inform business development efforts
Analyze internal and external data to spot emerging market trends and potential business development opportunities
Distill information from multiple sources into clear, concise and actionable deliverables
Help develop analysis and business development content for pitches, client opportunities, strategic planning and other practice-facing projects
Gain in-depth familiarity with the firm's service offerings, clients and prospects to flag and share actionable business development opportunities
Help set up, refresh and track news alerts covering clients, prospects and other relevant entities using the firm's available resources
Work alongside the firm's Business Intelligence team on detailed research into companies, industries, market developments and emerging trends
Team with senior business development professionals and colleagues at every level on research and monitoring initiatives, building insight into the firm's expertise, clients, engagements, competitors and market position
Help keep prospecting trackers, monitoring tools and other business development resources current and continually improved
Become proficient in the firm's internal systems and data resources and combine them with external research

Qualifications:

2 to 5 years of experience in competitive intelligence, market research or business development support, delivering data and insights that drive marketing or lead generation
Experience working in a large professional services environment, including but not limited to financial services, consulting, legal, marketing, advertising, market research and/or technology
Excellent interpersonal skills with an ability to communicate effectively across teams and departments
Sharp analytical and critical thinking skills with an exceptional eye for detail
Intellectual curiosity and a team-oriented approach

new_jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
We've been helping our members save for their future and buy their own home since 1875. Join us and you'll play a big role in helping us to put home ownership within reach of more people, generation after generation.

It's a purpose that drives everything we do. And you can play your part too – join our Data team as a BI Analyst.

How you'll make a difference

Reporting to the BI Reporting Team Leader, you will combine your strong knowledge of data analysis, reporting and visualisation techniques with strong business area knowledge to deliver actionable insight for our internal stakeholders. You'll be responsible for:

Creating, improving and migrating reports, visualisations and dashboards using enterprise BI tools.
Working closely with stakeholders to understand their reporting needs and translate them into clear, practical solutions.
Using data analysis and SQL skills to interrogate data, identify trends and produce trusted insight.
Supporting data lineage assessments, report attribute mappings and user acceptance testing.
Working with data warehouse developers as new and enhanced data marts are created.
Working cross-functionally within project teams using approaches such as Agile, Scrum, Kanban or Waterfall.

We’re looking for a versatile Senior Revenue Operations Analyst who enjoys connecting the details to the bigger business picture. You’ll own sales compensation and tackle a range of other analytical and operational challenges that help Fleetio’s go-to-market teams perform at their best.

You’ll run the monthly commission process, maintain accurate plans, and help our teams understand and trust their payouts. Alongside that ownership, you’ll analyze performance trends, strengthen reporting, and improve the processes that support our revenue organization.

Resolve data and payout discrepancies by identifying root causes, clearly explaining findings, and maintaining records of adjustments.
Lead investigative funnel analyses from exploration to practical recommendations, uncovering growth drivers and shaping the team’s focus.
Empower sales leadership with a clear view of pipeline health, conversion velocity, and revenue attainment through high-impact reports and executive dashboards.
Collaborate across teams on territory design, capacity planning, and target-setting, using data to evaluate options and trade-offs.
Streamline recurring workflows in partnership with systems and operational teams, leveraging AI to reduce manual effort and maintain high accuracy.
Document processes and business rules to ensure scalability, repeatability, and strong cross-functional trust.

What You Bring

4+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, Compensation Operations, Finance, or a similar analytical role in B2B SaaS or a recurring-revenue business.

You’re comfortable asking questions and respectfully challenging assumptions when the data points elsewhere.
You’ve owned a recurring process or project from start to finish and made it better along the way.

You have hands-on experience with Salesforce (or a similar CRM) and QuotaPath (or similar commissions software).

You’re curious about AI and automation and can spot practical ways to improve analysis and workflows, with thoughtful validation of the results.

Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Waymo’s Product Data Science team works cross-functionally with Engineering, Product and Operations to help the company make the most informed decisions using data. Architect and scale data infrastructure to support automated reporting for Road Rule Events, improving operational transparency and safety insights
Quantify our operational capacity to handle events, providing actionable data to scale team performance and optimize response protocols
